welcome.title: Welcome to TPA
welcome.subtitle: Trains, Planes and Automobiles (and Boats)
lines: A live map of UK transport: planes, trains, buses and road traffic.
Free for everyone, always. No adverts and no subscriptions.
This is a test version. Live layers show real data; anything marked MOCK is a pretend example.

tip.label: Buy me a coffee
tip.note: Completely optional. TPA stays free either way.

credits.text: Bus data sourced via the Department for Transport's Bus Open Data Service (BODS). Between reports, positions are estimated for up to 30 seconds.

Contains information of Network Rail Infrastructure Limited licensed under the following licence: Network Rail Infrastructure Limited Data Feeds Licence. Station locations: DfT NaPTAN (Open Government Licence). Junction and timing-point locations: YA TIPLOC list (CC BY-SA 4.0 / OGL / CC BY 2.0 UK). Trains are shown at the last place they reported; between reports their position is estimated.
Aircraft positions from ADSB.lol (Open Database License). Between reports, positions are estimated from speed and direction.
